sentences.text: Sam y Ana toman café en la casa.
sentences.english: Sam and Ana drink coffee at the house.
Sam wants to talk about yesterday.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Sí, trabajé en la clínica hasta las cinco.
sentences.english: Yes, I worked at the clinic until five.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hablé con el médico y llamé por teléfono a una señora.
sentences.english: I talked with the doctor and called a lady on the phone.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Un señor tomó agua y esperó con su hija.
sentences.english: A man drank water and waited with his daughter.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Then I walked to the shop.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Antes de la casa, compré pan y frijoles.
sentences.english: Before the house, I bought bread and beans.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Then I went back to the house.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Yes, I cooked beans and rice.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Do you have time after work?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: No, I do not have much time.

sentences.text: Anoche la familia cenó en la casa.
sentences.english: Last night the family had dinner at the house.

sentences.text: Doña Marta llegó del mercado y cenó con todos.
sentences.english: Doña Marta came from the market and had dinner with everyone.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Last night I prayed for the family.

sections.title: El domingo de Luis y Nico

sentences.text: El domingo Luis y Nico caminaron a la iglesia.
sentences.english: On Sunday Luis and Nico walked to church.

sentences.text: Nico jugó con su juego pequeño.
sentences.english: Nico played with his small game.

sentences.text: Luis y Nico regresaron a la casa a las doce.
sentences.english: Luis and Nico went back to the house at twelve.

sentences.text: En la casa, doña Marta pagó la comida.
sentences.english: At home, doña Marta paid for the food.

sentences.text: No quedó pan en la bolsa.
sentences.english: No bread was left in the bag.

sentences.text: Nico jugó solo en el cuarto.
sentences.english: Nico played alone in the room.

sentences.text: Este cipote siempre pierde la mochila.
sentences.english: This boy always loses his school bag.

sentences.text: Anoche buscó la mochila en el cuarto.
sentences.english: Last night he looked for the bag in the room.

sentences.text: Ana y Luis buscaron con Nico.
sentences.english: Ana and Luis looked with Nico.

sentences.text: Ana encontró la mochila en la cama.
sentences.english: Ana found the bag on the bed.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Antes de dormir, tomá la mochila.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: We are going to bed right now.
The two of them talked a lot.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: Did you find your school bag?

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: Yes, Ana found my school bag.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: Do you want to read a book?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Después hablé con el pastor en la iglesia.
sentences.english: Afterwards I talked with the pastor at church.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Yes, he needed water and bread.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Entonces caminé por la calle y compré agua.
sentences.english: Then I walked along the street and bought water.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Terminé de estudiar a las nueve.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Entonces ya hablás bien con la gente de aquí.
sentences.english: Then you already speak well with the people here.

sentences.text: Ana ve a Sam y a doña Marta.
sentences.english: Ana sees Sam and doña Marta.

sentences.text: Ana y doña Marta hablan y hablan.
sentences.english: Ana and doña Marta talk and talk.

sentences.text: Así pasa el día en la casa.
sentences.english: That is how the day passes in the house.

sentences.text: Hoy es lunes y todos tienen que trabajar.
sentences.english: Today is Monday and everyone has to work.

sentences.text: Ana toma su bolsa y va a la clínica con Luis.
sentences.english: Ana takes her bag and goes to the clinic with Luis.

sentences.text: Nico toma su mochila y va a la escuela.
sentences.english: Nico takes his school bag and goes to school.

sentences.text: Sam toma café y mira el cuarto de Nico.
sentences.english: Sam drinks coffee and looks at Nico's room.
